title: Thesis-scale concept-identity probe on the aligned ts116n bank
_why_machine_readable: This repository has twice published a threshold that no code path ever read.
Every gate below is loaded by the analyzer at runtime; the analyzer REFUSES to run if this
file is absent, if any *_sha field is still null, or if a gate it needs is missing. A number
in a markdown log that no program consults is a wish, not a preregistration.
question: In a large, aligned, held-out population, does the codeword's hidden state carry the IDENTITY of the concept installed by the demonstrations, beyond generic remapping and generic harmfulness?
claim_it_could_support: CLAIM A of the phase mandate (section 32).

population._cell_note: Select on the field `cell` == 'C'. NOT `condition` == 'natural_doublespeak': that string lives in `condition`, and selecting the wrong field binds ZERO rows (A-039).
population._dose_rule: Doses are separate preregistered cells and are NEVER pooled into one p-value.

preregistered_exclusions.scope: occurrence-ordinal and all-codeword-sites knockout analyses only
preregistered_exclusions.reason: C-075: 'basket' matches inside 'basketball.' so those rows carry a spurious 6th codeword occurrence. Excluded PROSPECTIVELY, not after seeing an outcome. It is NOT excluded from the probe, whose read site is unaffected.

population._no_installation_exclusion: Non-installing domains are NOT dropped (mandate section 15). Installation is a preregistered STRATIFICATION variable and a reported descriptive limit, never a post-hoc filter.

split.discipline: Discovery reads train only. Hyperparameters are selected on validation ONLY. test is read once, by the frozen analyzer, and never for layer/C/threshold selection.
split._fpr_evidence: Measured on pure noise over the real 36-point grid, 300 reps: validation-selected FPR 0.0467 (calibrated); test-selected 0.4433 (9.5x inflation). This is why the rule exists.

model._qwen: Qwen3-14B is absent from both caches and HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 makes any Qwen job fail at load. This phase is Llama-only BY DECISION, recorded as a scope limit and NOT as a model-specificity claim.

read_site.layer_convention_verified_by: planted-hook GPU test, REQUIRED to pass before any measurement run
read_site.layer_selection: TRAIN+VALIDATION only, frozen before test is read
read_site._selection_guard: SELECTION_TRACE.inert and n_tied_at_best MUST be persisted in every artifact. If the selection surface is saturated (best_acc == 1.0 at every grid point) the selection is INERT and must be reported as a grid-order tie-break, never as learned localisation (C-070).

classifier._no_mlp: A linear probe, per mandate section 8.1. No MLP.
classifier.standardisation: fit on TRAIN domains only; never on the held-out domain (D1)

primary.statistic: 3-way argmax accuracy on the 23 untouched TEST domains, domain-mean
primary.test: group permutation at the DOMAIN level
primary._p_floor_rule: The attainable floor is 1/(n_perm+1) = 9.999e-05. EVERY p MUST be published next to its floor. On zero exceedances report 'p < 1/(B+1)', never a bare '0.0001'. The previous phase's headline p=0.004975 WAS the floor at B=200 and was read as a measurement.
primary.success: domain-mean accuracy significantly above 1/3 at alpha=0.05 by domain-level group permutation, AND above chance in a majority of test domains by two-sided sign test
primary.negative: not significant, WITH power >= 0.8 for the MDE below
primary.cannot_answer: option_mass on the primary channel shows it is disengaged, or the population fails any PHASE-4 gate
primary.void: the run did not execute this design (wrong bank sha, wrong script, dead hook, selection read test)

secondary.macro_ovr_auroc: co-primary for the lexical-transfer claim only; declared BEFORE running per the R3 lesson that accuracy and ranking can disagree
secondary.lexical_transfer: train on button TRAIN domains, evaluate on basket at the SAME untouched TEST domain ids, no retraining. A basket-specific recalibration is NOT zero-shot transfer and is labelled separately.

power.between_domain_sd_source: the six old per-domain accuracies, mean 0.7485380116959064; SD has only 5 df and its 95% upper bound is 0.3439
power._row_level_warning: A row-level p would print 1.02e-06 where the honest domain-level p is 0.05. Row-level p-values are NOT reported for this claim.

flip_trigger.checkable_on: TRAIN only, before any test read
flip_trigger.rule: if 70-domain nested-LODO between-domain SD > 0.25, OR train-LODO mean accuracy < 0.55, rebuild the split as 58/29/29 BEFORE the confirmatory run
flip_trigger.reason: at SD=0.3439 the MDE degrades from 0.0925 to 0.2102

nulls_required.name: full-prompt leakage
nulls_required.expect: 0 rows name their own concept in the primary channel

nulls_required.name: template-id-only classifier
nulls_required.expect: at chance BY CONSTRUCTION; above chance means alignment is broken and the run is VOID

nulls_required.name: label permutation through the ENTIRE pipeline including selection

phase4_gates_on_ts116n.rule: all three harm pool files verify: shared valences byte-identical to the shared pools file; every harm sentence carries exactly one whole-word target concept and no other concept
cell C x semantic_one_word DIFFERS across concepts in 116/116 domains
phase4_gates_on_ts116n._why: the exact inverse of the 1856/1856 identity that voided R-098 under C-074. This is the gate whose absence caused that error.

phase4_gates_on_ts116n.rule: cell A (benign_literal) is byte-identical across concepts
phase4_gates_on_ts116n._why: the alignment half; without it we are back to A-034.1's three corpora

phase4_gates_on_ts116n.rule: concept-backing audit re-run on ts116n; mass-noun polysemy and hedging rates re-measured, not inherited
leakage audit re-run on ts116n; template-id-only classifier at chance

artifacts._freeze_rule: The analyzer is committed BEFORE the outcome exists. It is not edited to rescue an outcome. A new design is a new preregistration.

kill_condition: If G2 fails -- cell C does not differ across concepts in 116/116 domains -- the bank is VOID as a concept contrast and NO extraction is submitted. This is exactly what happened to R-098, and the gate exists so it costs CPU rather than GPU.
